name: MPSEDC Indore-Dewas Corridor Datacenter Farm
developer: Madhya Pradesh State Electronics Development Corporation / Government of Madhya Pradesh
notes: Conference coverage quotes MPSEDC's State Data Center in-charge saying Madhya Pradesh proposed an approximately 80-acre datacenter farm between Indore and Dewas, about 8.5 km from Indore city. Exact parcel/district boundary and follow-on approvals were not found; recorded against the Dewas corridor division with cautious status.

name: RackBank Indore (Central 2) / Pithampur AI Data Center
notes: RackBank announced a purpose-built AI datacenter near Indore with 80 MW power secured in four 20 MW phases and 60,000 GPU capacity. Baxtel places the RackBank Indore/Central 2 site by Pithampur Industrial Area, which is in Dhar district; RackBank's own site also references hiring for Pithampur locations. Treated as Dhar/Pithampur but location remains metro-branded as Indore.

name: RackBank DC SEZ 1, Crystal IT Park Indore
notes: RackBank's official site says its Indore-headquartered datacenter spans about 35,000 sq ft with 800+ racks and is still growing. DataCenterMap lists RackBank DC SEZ 1 at Crystal IT Park (SEZ), Ring Road, Indore.

name: MPSEDC Betma Data Centre Park
developer: Madhya Pradesh State Electronics Development Corporation; interested developers included RackBank and NxtGen
notes: 2015 reporting said land allotment and funding had cleared for a data centre park at Betma near Indore and that work was expected to start within months, with RackBank and NxtGen expressing interest. No current confirmation of completion was found during this pass, so status is left unknown.
